limits: Format-specific semantic scope is per file; no complete content acceptance.
ZIP members were not extracted or CRC-read; OOXML archive CRC was checked.
No automatic retry loop; a timed-out or unreached parse remains explicit.
A source-faithful malformed payload is an input-content issue, not evidence of transfer corruption.

text/content.scope: Sandboxed Python extracts and checks known data; semantic criterion correctness is not inferred.

structure.scope: Document structure, layered PSD and notebook serialization; specific submitted originals still require inspection.

visual.scope: Actual compatible Office page rendering and source-bound selected video-frame extraction/view/validation. Perception accuracy and actual page/frame coverage are independent.

spreadsheet_recalc.scope: Prior copied-workbook perturbation yielded24 expected values. Same Office bytes; no native Excel UI claim and no replacement of judge work.

interactive_execution.scope: Offline Node handler, Python widget callback, actual React Testing Library/Sinon/TypeScript API execution and a fresh actual in-process ipykernel. No native browser, accessibility tree, deployed service or separate-process Jupyter route.

source_comparison.scope: Public retrieval and actual evidence binding checked; correctness of each source comparison remains task-specific.

CAD_geometry.scope: Known STEP solid volume6000 and two-component assembly round-trip/inspection; byte-identical OCP reused. Later123s authoring/import timeout preserved; cold-start reliability is not guaranteed.

audio_listen.scope: Audio authoring/filtering and measurements work. CLI cannot hear; perception requires a named reviewer and actual listening.

video_temporal.scope: H264 codec, durations/frames and PNG extraction verified; selected frames do not establish temporal perception.

native_app.scope: Presence, structure, text and static facts are mechanical/AI observations;32 actual app-operation items need verified native/control routes. Do not relabel those infrastructure gaps as inherently human.

model_envelope.billing: existing subscriptions only; no extra usage, API billing or auxiliary AI
